nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a vertex set $V$ and let $A \subseteq V$. If $v$ is an external neighbour of $A$ in $G$, then $v$ is adjacent in $G$ to some vertex $a \in A$.
nodes.title: External neighbours have a neighbour in the set

nodes.summary: For every simple graph $G$ on a vertex set $V$ and every set $A \subseteq V$, the external neighbourhood of $A$ in $G$ is disjoint from $A$.
nodes.title: The external neighbourhood is disjoint from the set

nodes.summary: For a simple graph $G$ on a vertex set $V$ and a set $A \subseteq V$, the external neighbourhood of $A$ in $G$ is the set of vertices $v \notin A$ that are adjacent in $G$ to some vertex of $A$.
nodes.title: External neighbourhood

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set $V$ with $n$ vertices, and let $C$ be a real number. Then $G$ is a $C$-expander if $C > 0$, every set $A \subseteq V$ with $|A| < n/(2C)$ has an external neighbourhood in $G$ with at least $C|A|$ vertices, and for any two disjoint sets $A, B \subseteq V$ with $|A| \ge n/(2C)$ and $|B| \ge n/(2C)$ some vertex of $A$ is adjacent in $G$ to some vertex of $B$.
nodes.title: C-expander

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set $V$ and let $h$ be a real number. Then $G$ is a uniform vertex expander with parameter $h$ if $h > 0$ and every set $S \subseteq V$ with $|S| \le |V|/2$ has an external neighbourhood in $G$ with at least $h|S|$ vertices.
nodes.title: Uniform vertex expander

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set $V$ with $n$ vertices, let $C$ be a real number, and suppose $G$ is a $C$-expander. If $A, B \subseteq V$ are disjoint sets with $|A| \ge n/(2C)$ and $|B| \ge n/(2C)$, then some vertex $a \in A$ is adjacent in $G$ to some vertex $b \in B$.
nodes.title: Large disjoint sets in a C-expander span an edge

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a vertex set $V$, let $A \subseteq V$ and let $v \in V$. Then $v$ lies in the external neighbourhood of $A$ in $G$ if and only if $v \notin A$ and $v$ is adjacent in $G$ to some vertex $a \in A$.
nodes.title: Membership in the external neighbourhood

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set $V$ and let $h$ be a real number. If $G$ is a uniform vertex expander with parameter $h$, then $h > 0$.
nodes.title: The parameter of a uniform vertex expander is positive

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set $V$ and let $C$ be a real number. If $G$ is a $C$-expander, then $C > 0$.
nodes.title: The parameter of a C-expander is positive

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a simple graph on a finite vertex set $V$ and let $h$ be a real number. If $G$ is a uniform vertex expander with parameter $h$ and $S \subseteq V$ satisfies $|S| \le |V|/2$, then the external neighbourhood of $S$ in $G$ has at least $h|S|$ vertices.
nodes.title: Small sets expand in a uniform vertex expander

nodes.summary: Let $C$ be a real number and let $G$ be a $C$-expander on a finite vertex set $V$. Then every set $A \subseteq V$ with $|A| < |V|/(2C)$ has at least $C|A|$ external neighbours, that is, at least $C|A|$ vertices outside $A$ are adjacent to some vertex of $A$.
nodes.title: Small sets expand in a $C$-expander

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
